title: Import from {format}

descriptions.hydro: Restore one or more problems from a Hydro problem-set archive.
descriptions.fps: Import problems from a Free Problem Set XML file or ZIP archive.
descriptions.hoj: Import a problem-set ZIP archive exported by HOJ.
descriptions.qduoj: Import a problem-set ZIP archive exported by QDUOJ or compatible OnlineJudge systems.
descriptions.lvj: Import a problem from a supported remote online judge using its problem ID.

pidHelp: The ID used by the selected online judge, such as 1712A or 1001.

fileHelp.hydro: Choose a .zip archive exported by Hydro.
fileHelp.fps: Choose an FPS .xml file or a .zip containing FPS files.
fileHelp.hoj: Choose the .zip file exported from HOJ.
fileHelp.qduoj: Choose the .zip file exported from QDUOJ.

preferredPrefixPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the default
preferredPrefixHelp: Letters only. It is used when an imported problem ID needs to be replaced.
preferredPrefixInvalid: The prefix can contain letters only.
hiddenHelp: Only users with the relevant permission can see the imported problems.
keepUserHelp: Use only for archives exported from this system.

aboutText.hydro: Hydro archives preserve statements, test data, additional files, and problem configuration.
aboutText.fps: FPS is an XML exchange format supported by many online judge systems.
aboutText.hoj: The HOJ importer reads the problem metadata, examples, test cases, special judge, and extra files from its export archive.
aboutText.qduoj: The QDUOJ importer reads problem.json, test cases, scores, and supported special judge settings.
aboutText.lvj: Import a problem from a supported remote online judge using its problem ID.

fpsMemoryWarning: Large FPS XML files can use significant memory while being parsed. Split unusually large packages before importing.
importNotice: Importing may take a while. Do not close this page until the upload completes.
importFailed: Failed to import the problem set. Check the file format and try again.
